queries:
SELECT
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes > 10323804

SELECT
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes >= 10323804

SELECT
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice,
    1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes > 10323804

SELECT
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS AverageUnitPrice,
    CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes >= 10323804

WITH purchased_tracks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.TrackId,
           CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds AS bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    WHERE t.Milliseconds > 0
),
tracks_above_cutoff AS (
    SELECT TrackId, bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM purchased_tracks
    WHERE bytes_per_millisecond > :cutoff
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(il.UnitPrice)
     FROM InvoiceLine AS il
     JOIN tracks_above_cutoff AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId) AS average_unit_price,
    (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond)
     FROM tracks_above_cutoff) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond

WITH purchased_tracks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.TrackId, t.Bytes, t.Milliseconds
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
  WHERE t.Milliseconds >= :cutoff
)
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(il.UnitPrice)
   FROM InvoiceLine AS il
   JOIN purchased_tracks AS pt ON pt.TrackId = il.TrackId) AS avg_unit_price,
  (SELECT AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds)
   FROM purchased_tracks) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
